name: Active Threats: AWS Storage
description: The Active Threats: AWS Storage dashboard shows threats identified from AWS S3 CloudTrail Events. It shows threats count and trend, and threats by resource, actor, events, and geo location.
title: Active Threats: AWS Storage

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "userIdentity", "eventTime", "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress", "userAgent", "errorCode", "requestParameters", "eventType" as userIdentity, event_time, eventSource, event.action, cloud.region, client.ip, user_agent, event.outcome, requestParameters, eventType nodrop
| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json field=userIdentity "type", "accountId", "userName" as userType, cloud.account.id, user.name
| json field=requestParameters "bucketName" as cloud.instance.id
| parse field=eventSource "*." as cloud.service.name
| if (userType matches("IAMUser"), "user", "machine") as event.agent

| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence, threat from sumo://threat/cs on threat=client.ip
| where type="ip_address"

| if (malicious_confidence = "low", 1, 0) as risk.static_level
| if (malicious_confidence = "medium", 2, risk.static_level) as risk.static_level
| if (malicious_confidence = "high", 3, risk.static_level) as risk.static_level

// handle empty values
| if (isEmpty(event.outcome), "Success", event.outcome) as event.outcome
| if (isEmpty(user.name), "NA", user.name) as user.name
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as actor
| if(isEmpty(cloud.account.id), "NA", cloud.account.id) as cloud.account.id

// global filters
| where if ("{{cloud.instance.id}}" = "*", true, cloud.instance.id matches "{{cloud.instance.id}}") AND if ("{{event.action}}" = "*", true, event.action matches "{{event.action}}") AND if ("{{user.name}}" = "*", true, user.name matches "{{user.name}}") AND if ("{{event.action}}" = "*", true, event.action matches "{{event.action}}") AND if ("{{client.ip}}" = "*", true, client.ip matches "{{client.ip}}") AND if ("{{risk.static_level}}" = "*", true, risk.static_level >= toInt("{{risk.static_level}}")) AND if ("{{threat.group.name}}" = "*", true, actor matches "{{threat.group.name}}") AND if ("{{source.user}}" = "*", true, source.user matches "{{source.user}}}")

| count

sourceDefinition.query:
_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventSource", "requestParameters" as eventSource, requestParameters
| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json field=requestParameters "bucketName" as cloud.instance.id

_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventSource", "eventName" as eventSource, event.action
| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"

_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "userIdentity", "eventSource" as userIdentity, eventSource
| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json field=userIdentity "userName" as user.name
| if (isEmpty(user.name), "NA", user.name) as user.name

_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventSource", "sourceIPAddress" as eventSource, client.ip
| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"

_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "userIdentity", "eventTime", "eventSource", "eventName", "awsRegion", "sourceIPAddress", "userAgent", "errorCode", "requestParameters", "eventType" as userIdentity, event_time, eventSource, event.action, cloud.region, client.ip, user_agent, event.outcome, requestParameters, eventType nodrop

| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json field=userIdentity "type", "accountId", "userName" as user_identity_type, cloud.account.id, user.name

| if (user_identity_type in ("IAMUser","Root"), "Yes", "No") as source.user

_sourceCategory=*CloudTrail* "s3.amazonaws.com"
| json "eventSource", "sourceIPAddress" as eventSource, client.ip
| where eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"

| where !isPrivateIP(client.ip)
| lookup actor as threat.group.name from sumo://threat/cs on threat=client.ip
| where !isNull(threat.group.name) 
| where !isEmpty(threat.group.name)
| where !isBlank(threat.group.name)
| count by threat.group.name
